ModMetaData.name: IsoRim ProjectZ
ModMetaData.author: Lin
ModMetaData.description:
Work-in-progress prototype. Not for normal play yet.
Stacked floors for IsoRim Waylith, all on one map.
- Changes gameplay: new maps get extra space for upper floors. - Build stairs on a roofed cell and upper floors over roofed rooms; pick the floor you work on with the button in the bottom-right corner or the = and - keys. - Not safe to remove from a save that has floors.
Path splicing idea from MigCorp - Skiptech (TheMiggiestMig). 路径拼接思路参考 MigCorp - Skiptech（TheMiggiestMig）
